# values data flow

[Project overview](../../index.md)

This view opens the values folder one level deeper. Each arrow shows the called operation and the data it returns to its caller. Calls inside a file stay in that file’s sequence view.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    n0["math"]
    n1["ascii"]
    n2["dates"]
    n3["durations"]
    n4["paths"]
    n5["urls"]
    n2 -->|"asciiSlice(input, start, …) → string"| n1
    n3 -->|"checkedAdd(left, right) / checkedMultiply(left, right) → int"| n0
    n3 -->|"asciiSlice(input, start, …) → string"| n1
    n4 -->|"asciiAt(input, index) / asciiLetter(character) + 1 more → bool / string"| n1
    n5 -->|"asciiAt(input, index) / asciiLetter(character) + 2 more → bool / string"| n1
```
